messages:
mona: Quick check — ran Orchard9B int6/int4 smoke runs on a small GTN slice. Results attached below. Anyone free to sanity-check unit econ and quality before I escalate to canary?

devon: I am. ping me the numbers :eyes:

mona: OK paste: int6: 8.9 tokens/ms median latency @ batch=1, throughput 950 tok/s, cost ~ $1.8 per 1M tokens. int4: 9.5 tokens/ms, 1050 tok/s, cost ~ $1.2 per 1M tokens.

kai: How are you measuring cost? infra spot pricing? Include cache hit assumptions.

mona: Using dedicated inference pricing model (reserved GPU), with KV cache hit ~ 12% (synthetic workload). Numbers are amortized across warm KV.

anya: Quality scan (n=200 GTN prompts)
- int6 ROUGE-L drop: 0.9 pts vs fp16
- int4 ROUGE-L drop: 2.7 pts vs fp16
- Longform coherence failures (hallucination) increased in int4 for prompts > 800 tokens

devon: So int6 looks like sweetspot for now: ~33% cheaper than fp16? What's fp16 baseline cost?

mona: fp16 baseline ~ $2.7 per 1M tokens in our reserved pool. So int6 ~33% cheaper, int4 ~55% cheaper vs fp16.

kai: Unit-econ calc: with traffic mix (avg length 250 tokens, 5 req/s per instance), int6 would reduce monthly infra bill by ~18% on this route. But int4 regression might cost product in GTN (user-visible QA fail rate + timeouts).

product_ops_bot: deploy-bot: canary slot available in prod-eu-1. Use tag orchard9b-int6-canary.

anya: Recommend strategy: 1) Canary int6 at 10% traffic with strict eval hooks (GTN slice + automated coherence detector). 2) Shadow int4 but route <1% traffic, no fallback yet. 3) Instrument per-prompt quality labels for first 100k impressions.

devon: For GTN guidance: tell product to prepare rollback criteria: increase in user complaints or >1.5% drop in QA pass on GTN slice.

mona: Agree. I'll draft a short scorecard for GTN: latency, p50/p95, cost per 1M, rouge-l delta, hallucination flag rate. Send to PM for signoff.

kai: One more ask: add a small priming experiment (5 tokens fewer priming lines) — we saw int4 hallucination sensitive to context framing.

mona: Noted. I'll queue that in the smoke pipeline. Thanks all :thumbsup:

anya: I'll own the canary monitoring dashboard and alert thresholds.

devon: LGTM. Proceed with int6 canary. int4 stays blocked until triage complete.

mona: Rolling plan: canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC, keep at 10% for 48h, then evaluate scorecard. Will post results here.

product: FYI — PMs prepped GTN slice, will be watching metrics and user signals.

mona: Thanks — will post results and a compact JSON scorecard afterwards.
